title: The 4 Best Foam Rollers Under $20
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for foam rollers under $20, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at foam rollers under $20 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Amazon Basics High-Density Foam Roller
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-inch smooth-surface EPP foam, High-density, holds shape under body weight, Lightweight at under 1 pound.
strengths: High-density foam holds up well for general daily use
24-inch length is practical for most full-body rolling
limitations: No texture for targeted knot work
No rigid core, so it can compress faster than premium rollers under very heavy daily use
features: High-density, holds shape under body weight

products.name: LuxFit Foam Roller
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-inch molded polypropylene foam, 2 lb per cubic foot density, Smooth, speckled surface.
strengths: 3-year warranty is unusual at this price point and the longest of any roller in this category
Molded polypropylene foam holds its shape well according to owner reports
Smooth surface is comfortable for daily general-purpose use
limitations: No texture for targeted knot work
Fewer total ratings than Amazon Basics

products.name: Gaiam Restore Foam Roller, 18-Inch
strengths: Compact 18-inch length for legs and arms
EVA foam keeps its shape better than cheap open-cell foam
limitations: Too short to roll the back lengthwise
Smooth surface gives general, not targeted, pressure

products.name: ProsourceFit High Density Foam Roller
limitations: Firm feel can be intense at first
Molded foam can dent with heavy use

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
